name: Lewis Mint's Summer of Love
source:
New town, new house, new circles. All seems to be becoming in order in Lewis Mint's life, yet he feels something is missing. Alas, so it is that a human being is quite frail. Some kind of warmth is needed to fulfill his heart, some spice to make it interesting and someone to keep him company. There is nothing like a warm breath on.. well. 

What does the new setting have in store for Lewis Mint? Because indeed, all you need is love - regardless of where it comes from.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/reneissancegames]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
新的城镇，新的房子，新的圈子。刘易斯·明特的生活似乎一切都井然有序，但他却感觉缺少了一些东西。唉，原来人是很脆弱的。需要某种温暖来满足他的心，需要一些香料来让他变得有趣，需要有人来陪伴他。没有什么比温暖的呼吸更好的了……好吧。

新的设置为刘易斯薄荷带来了什么？因为事实上，你所需要的只是爱——无论它来自哪里。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/reneissancegames]Patreon[/url]]
